# Joey — Autonomous Social Media Agent
> An open-source, BYOK social media automation platform powered by the Eve framework.

## Core Features

- **Eve-Powered Agentic AI:** Joey uses advanced agentic workflows to understand context, format constraints, and your unique brand persona. It analyzes brand voice, curates content, and drafts high-performing social posts.
- **Visual Flows Studio:** Node-based automation pipelines connecting Exa AI web search, RSS ingestion, LLM drafting, and multi-platform publishing with cron scheduling.
- **Theme Studio:** Custom visual social card templates, slide carousels, dynamic SVG-to-PNG export via Resvg, and editorial mix pipelines.
- **Telegram Mobile Approvals:** Instant notifications on your phone with media previews and 1-tap Approve/Reject buttons via Telegram Bot.
- **Multi-Model BYOK Chat:** Live model selector supporting Google Gemini 2.5/3.8 Flash, OpenAI GPT-5.6/GPT-4o, and Anthropic Claude Haiku with zero middleman markup.
- **Unified Engagement Inbox:** Cross-network tracking for comments and direct messages with AI-generated reply suggestions.
- **Human in the Loop:** Nothing goes live without your explicit approval. Review, tweak, and approve agent-generated drafts before they publish.
- **Cross-Platform Publishing:** Powered by Zernio. Post to Twitter/X, LinkedIn (Profiles and Company Pages), Facebook Pages, and Pinterest.

## Key Details

- **License:** MIT (open source)
- **Pricing:** BYOK (bring your own API keys) — no mandatory subscription
- **Tech Stack:** Built on the Eve framework, Next.js, TypeScript
- **Parent Company:** Evonera
- **GitHub:** https://github.com/evonera/joey

## FAQ

- **What is Joey?** Joey is an autonomous social media agent that analyzes your brand voice, curates relevant content, and drafts high-performing social posts on autopilot. You just review and approve.
- **Is Joey open source?** Yes, Joey is open source under the MIT license. Source code is available on GitHub.
- **How does Human in the Loop work?** Joey generates posts based on your brand voice and scheduling preferences, but nothing publishes without your manual approval. You can edit any draft before it goes live.
- **What platforms are supported?** Twitter/X, LinkedIn, Facebook are supported via the Zernio cross-platform publishing engine.
- **How is Joey different from Buffer/Hootsuite?** Joey uses AI agentic workflows to autonomously create content, not just schedule it. It learns your brand voice and generates platform-specific posts.
